name: Advanced Computational Materials Modelling
description: Functional properties of materials: an overview; electronic, optical, magnetic, and mechanical properties of solids; basic foundations of materials modeling at atomic-scale; many-electron problems and initial approximations; basics of spin-polarized density functional theory (DFT) and its applications; electronic structure using beyond DFT-based techniques such as GW methods; time-dependent DFT and BSE-GW methods for optical properties; different magnetic interactions in extended solids; computing transition temperatures; evaluation of elastic constants of various materials of varied dimension; practical: hands-on on basic simulation set-up for 3D materials; computing highly accurate electronic and optical properties using beyond-DFT techniques; modeling magnetic interactions and mechanical properties of wide variety of solids.
